claims.atomic_claim: The latest Nightfall release tag is visible through git ls-remote.
claims.limitation: Tag visibility does not prove binary provenance.

claims.atomic_claim: Nightfall release assets have GitHub uploader metadata.
claims.limitation: GitHub uploader metadata is not a cryptographic signature.
Checksum presence does not prove independent trust.

claims.atomic_claim: Every binary-like asset is referenced by checksum file content by filename.
claims.limitation: Filename coverage does not prove checksum correctness unless local hashes are computed.
Signature detection is name-based and still requires public-key verification.
Safety cannot be inferred from release metadata, checksums or uploaders alone.
